style: cinematic 3D cartoon, Pixar quality, slapstick comedy, deadpan irony
motion_rule: camera locked at his eye level all clip, jolting only on the mic at 0.0 and the drop at 9.7; he grows in frame only by walking at the lens at 0.9 and 4.5. He is in frame every second up to 9.3; the set never moves
character: HERO: lanky stubbly shift-worker mosquito, heavy-lidded eyes, long proboscis, work shirt
cast: NEIGHBOUR: a second mosquito with an identical sack, backlit silhouette, crosses at the lens in 0.3 s at 6.1. Two more scatter large in front at 7.3. Not copies of the HERO, none speak
props: SACK: glossy ruby-red ball-sack on straps, taut rubbery, holds its round shape, ripples once on impact and rounds back, never bursts or leaks. BEAD: same, half the size, on a thin thread. MIC: shotgun mic in grey foam on a boom, no hand or interviewer. GLASS: one tall glass at the left, always in frame
prop_continuity: sack on his back 0.0-2.1; on the table and HIS BACK BARE 2.1-4.5; the bead lands on his back at 4.2 and stays; both on him 4.5-9.3
setting: a wooden terrace table at night under a hanging lamp; bright and readable, warm lamp pool over the tabletop, cyan rim left, magenta kick right, high contrast

audio.language: Russian, exactly the words in the line fields; latin hints are never spoken
audio.delivery: weary deadpan male chest voice near 130 Hz, even 4.3 syllables/sec
audio.pacing: one pause only, 7.3-7.9, silent; the 4.5 and 6.1 lines run together with no breath; no other pause, endings voiced, nothing after 9.3
audio.lip_sync: mouth opening and closing on every syllable, never a voice over

timeline.a: silent. The mic rams in point blank; he recoils whole-body, the sack swings forward and folds his hind legs
he turns to the lens in one movement; the sack swings full circle, slams his back, he steps forward
silent. He drops the sack on the table, BAM: it ripples and rounds back, the glass jumps, he pops up. HIS BACK IS BARE
both front legs sweep one wide arc round the sack, edge to edge. Back bare
silent. The bead comes down on its thread onto his back; he sinks flat to the boards
a jerk of the proboscis throws the sack from table to shoulder; three heavy steps at the lens, hind legs buckling
same sentence, no breath. The NEIGHBOUR blasts past at the lens and shoulders him; he spins half round, finishes over his shoulder
silent, the only pause. A palm shadow wipes across the table and is gone; two mosquitoes scatter large in front; he ducks only after it passed, then stares into the lens
the same over-shoulder yank, but the sack is already on him: he hauls himself to it instead and hangs on his wings
silent. The shadow dims the whole frame without hiding it, boards, glass and mic visible through it, then slides off an empty spot
one beat: sack and bead drop out of empty air, the sack ripples flat, the mic sways empty, the bead still rolling as the clip ends

must_appear: required despite the negatives: the NEIGHBOUR and his sack at 6.1, two mosquitoes at 7.3, the palm shadow at 7.3 and 9.3, the bead at 3.9
negative_prompt: blood, red liquid, splashes, the sack bursting, leaking or going flat, crushed or dead insect, a human hand, arm or person in frame, a second copy of the HERO, the HERO changing shirt or shape, a third sack on him, two glasses or mics, weightless props, cuts, jump cuts, any frame without the HERO before 9.3, camera pan, dolly, zoom, a fully black frame at 9.3, subtitles, captions, watermark, text overlay, English speech, foreign accent, drawn-out delivery, stretched vowels, swallowed endings
